Application Security

การบรรเทาการเปลี่ยนเส้นทางแบบเปิด

Security controls that detect and prevent web applications from redirecting users to untrusted external URLs, reducing the risk of phishing and credential theft.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

Security controls that detect and prevent web applications from redirecting users to untrusted external URLs, reducing the risk of phishing and credential theft.

Operational example

Implement Open Redirect Mitigation to validate redirect targets and ensure users are not sent to untrusted or malicious domains.
